contracts.name: TransposeFollowup.RecodedXorCode.broadcast_bound_of_ball_budget
contracts.header:
theorem broadcast_bound_of_ball_budget (hc : C.Correct) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n))
    (hG : C.LocalTo G) (k q e : ℕ)
    (hballs : ∀ i, (nearVertices G k i).card ≤ q)
    (hbudget : n + k * q ≤ (k + 1) * e) :
    n * n * b ≤ B + b * n * e

contracts.name: TransposeFollowup.RecodedXorCode.broadcast_bound_of_ball_budget_real
contracts.header:
theorem broadcast_bound_of_ball_budget_real (hc : C.Correct) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n))
    (hG : C.LocalTo G) (k q : ℕ) (e : ℝ)
    (hballs : ∀ i, (nearVertices G k i).card ≤ q)
    (hbudget : (n : ℝ) + k * q ≤ (k + 1) * e) :
    (n * n * b : ℕ) ≤ (B : ℝ) + (b : ℝ) * n * e

contracts.name: TransposeFollowup.RecodedXorCode.broadcast_lower_bound
contracts.header:
theorem broadcast_lower_bound (hc : C.Correct) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n))
    (hG : C.LocalTo G) (ell : ℕ) :
    (B : ℝ) ≥ (n * n * b : ℕ) -
      (((n * n * b : ℕ) : ℝ) + ell * (nearBits (b := b) G ell).card) / (ell + 1)

contracts.name: TransposeFollowup.RecodedXorCode.broadcast_lower_bound_scaled
contracts.header:
theorem broadcast_lower_bound_scaled (hc : C.Correct) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n))
    (hG : C.LocalTo G) (ell : ℕ) :
    (ell + 1) * (n * n * b) ≤ (ell + 1) * B + n * n * b +
      ell * (nearBits (b := b) G ell).card

contracts.name: TransposeFollowup.RecodedXorCode.cycle_broadcast_lower_bound
contracts.header:
theorem cycle_broadcast_lower_bound (hc : C.Correct)
    (hG : C.LocalTo (SimpleGraph.cycleGraph n)) (hn : 0 < n) :
    (B : ℝ) ≥ (n * n * b : ℕ) - (b : ℝ) * n * (Real.sqrt (8 * ((n : ℝ) + 3)) - 4)

contracts.name: TransposeFollowup.RecodedXorCode.cycle_embedding_broadcast_lower_bound

    (B : ℝ) ≥ (n * n * b : ℕ) - (b : ℝ) * n * (Real.sqrt (8 * ((n : ℝ) + 3)) - 4)

contracts.name: TransposeFollowup.RecodedXorCode.degree_broadcast_bound_scaled
contracts.header:
theorem degree_broadcast_bound_scaled (hc : C.Correct) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n))
    [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hG : C.LocalTo G) (D : ℕ) (hD : 2 ≤ D)
    (hdegree : ∀ i, G.degree i ≤ D) (hn : 0 < n) :
    (Nat.log D n / 2 + 2) * (n * n * b) ≤
      (Nat.log D n / 2 + 2) * B + 3 * (n * n * b)

contracts.name: TransposeFollowup.RecodedXorCode.degree_broadcast_lower_bound
contracts.header:
theorem degree_broadcast_lower_bound (hc : C.Correct) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n))

contracts.header:

contracts.name: TransposeFollowup.submodular_cover
contracts.header:
theorem submodular_cover {ι κ : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype κ]
    (U : Finset ι) (f : Finset ι → ℝ)
    (hzero : f ∅ = 0)
    (hmono : Monotone f)
    (hsub : ∀ A B, f (A ∪ B) + f (A ∩ B) ≤ f A + f B)
    (S : κ → Finset ι) (hS : ∀ a, S a ⊆ U)
    (k : ℝ)
    (hcover : ∀ i ∈ U, k ≤ ∑ a, if i ∈ S a then (1 : ℝ) else 0) :
    k * f U ≤ ∑ a, f (S a)
